binding_constraint.name: executable_exit_for_leading_concentration
binding_constraint.scenario: Loss of raw-material supply from Vendor R
binding_constraint.basis: No second raw-material supplier is qualified, so no exit exists and no clock phase can be timed for the governing supplier-loss scenario.

tolerance_result.clock_start_event: Onset: an unplanned production stop (not tested for the governing scenario)
tolerance_result.clock_stop_event: Verified resumption of in-specification output (not tested for the governing scenario)

gates.note: Both concentrations and the mine dependency identified
Safety stop authority is clear and immediate
Only T1 tabletop for control loss, no supplier-loss test
Tolerance never tested for the governing scenario
Actions identified but not owned, dated or scheduled

top_breakpoints: No executable exit for Vendor R. Qualification takes 3 to 6 months and is unfunded.
Fourth-party concentration: a candidate second supplier may depend on the same mine in Jurisdiction Z.
Manual control is unproven on the line. A T1 tabletop is not execution.
Buffer runway is assumed at 18 hours but never tested to exhaustion.

escalation_items.issue: Single-source raw-material exposure with no qualified alternate
escalation_items.operational_consequence: A Vendor R loss stops production once buffer stock is exhausted
escalation_items.facts_required: Funding decision on second-supplier qualification; upstream mine dependency of candidate suppliers
escalation_items.decision_owner: Board, with a named owner for any accepted risk

escalation_items.issue: Live tests near buffer exhaustion or under manual control
escalation_items.operational_consequence: Safety hazard to line personnel and equipment
